title: Predicting the Performance of Functional Materials Composed of Polymeric Multicomponent Systems Using Artificial Intelligence-Formulations of Cleansing Foams as an Example
summary: Machine-learning models predict cleansing performance across 537 experimentally prepared foam formulations; measured eyeliner-removal outcomes support the formulation-performance result, with predictive performance assessed on held-out samples.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
